learning_outcomes.text: Students will have acquired advanced knowledge and demonstrated an understanding of the theoretical and practical aspects and the work methodology in their field of study with a depth that reaches the forefront of knowledge.

Students will know how to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional manner and possess the competences typically demonstrated by elaborating and defending arguments and solving problems in complex or professional and specialized work environments that require the use of creative and innovative ideas.

Students will have the ability to gather and interpret relevant data, usually within their area of study, to make judgments that include a reflection on relevant social, scientific, or ethical issues.
Students will know how to communicate to all types of audiences, specialized or not, clearly and precisely, knowledge, methodologies, ideas, problems, and solutions in the field of their study.

Students will have developed those learning skills necessary to identify their own training needs in their field of study and work or professional environment, and to undertake further studies with a high degree of autonomy in all types of contexts, structured or not.

Ability to draft, sign, and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering, whose purpose is the construction, reform, repair, conservation, demolition, manufacturing, installation, assembly, or operation of: structures, mechanical equipment, energy installations, electrical and electronic installations, industrial installations and plants, and manufacturing and automation processes.
Ability to direct the activities that are the object of the engineering projects described in the previous section.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Knowledge for performing measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans, and other similar works.
Ability to handle specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Ability to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Ability to apply quality principles and methods.
Ability to organize and plan in the business environment, and other institutions and organizations.
Ability to work in a multilingual and multidisciplinary environment.
Knowledge, understanding, and ability to apply the necessary legislation in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Ability to individually carry out a project in the field of Industrial Engineering, of a professional nature, in which the competencies acquired during the studies are synthesized and integrated.
Ability to present and defend the results obtained before a university committee.
Prepare, present, and defend individually an original professional project in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Deliver an oral presentation, optionally in English, and correctly answer questions from a specialized committee.
Communicate orally and in writing on complex topics.
Apply the competencies acquired during their studies to carry out a specific task.

assessment_rules: The assessment includes an oral presentation (30%) and a thesis document (70%). These components are not recoverable. No minimum marks are specified.
